div.h1: Getting Started with API Tester Pro
div.p: Explore Odoo's most powerful, full-featured developer utility. Test API endpoints, simulate client workflows, and collaborate with your team without leaving your ERP workspace.

div.style: background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
div.div: Send Requests Securely
Execute REST API requests using standard verbs like GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and HEAD directly from your Odoo server IP.

div.style: background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
div.div: Automatic Execution Logs
Never lose a test. The system automatically maintains a historical timeline of all runs with real-time logs, statuses, and performance timings.

div.style: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.03) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.03) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.15); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);

h3.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #4f46e5; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;

ol.style: margin-top: 14px; padding-left: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #334155; line-height: 1.6;
ol.li: Switch to the Tester menu on Odoo's top header.
Choose an HTTP method (e.g. GET) from the dropdown next to the URL input.
Type or paste your target URL (such as a mock REST endpoint).
Click the vibrant violet Send button. The server will run the call and load response headers, body, size, and timings instantly.

div.style: max-width: 800px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px;

span.style: background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08); color: #7c3aed; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-weight: 600;

div.p: Quickly import endpoints from Postman, Chrome DevTools, or terminal commands by pasting raw cURL expressions.

div.style: background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);

div.div: Copy any raw cURL command (e.g. curl --location 'https://api.com' ...).

div.style: background: #7c3aed; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: white; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.75rem;

div.div: Select the main URL input bar in the Tester workspace.

div.style: background: #7c3aed; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: white; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.75rem;

div.div: Paste the copied text directly into the input bar using Ctrl+V (or Cmd+V).

div.style: background: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #0f172a; line-height: 1.5; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);

div.div:
# Example Paste Support:
curl --location 'https://auth.dev.com/token' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
--data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials' \
--data-urlencode 'client_id=my_client_id'

div.p: Organize saved API requests into structured directories, nest folders recursively, and easily collaborate across your engineering team.

div.style: background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
div.div: Granular Team Sharing
Navigate to standard Odoo collection list/form views. Add users to the Shared Users list to instantly grant them CRUD permissions inside the shared workspace.

div.style: background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
div.div: Clear Attribution
Shared collections explicitly append the creator's username (e.g. MarketingSuite by Admin) so you always know who created or shared the test set.

div.p: When you delete an active request (saved curl) from the tree hierarchy, Odoo automatically protects historical logs by keeping them separated. Instead of being permanently unlinked, the history logs generated from that request are cleanly moved to archives (active=False) for structural reporting.

div.p: Configure request headers and access mechanisms easily inside active profiles.

Inject standard JSON Web Tokens (JWT) or OAuth bearer credentials. They will automatically be attached to the request's authorization header payload.

div.div: Basic Username & Password Auth
Enter raw username and password credentials. The client automatically base64-encodes these fields to output standard header attributes.

div.div: Custom API Key
Inject custom security keys into specified request target elements, such as customized request headers or URL query string parameters.

div.div: JSON (Application/JSON)
Compose rich JSON payloads using standard keys and arrays. Includes validation checks to avoid sending malformed JSON strings.

Input raw GraphQL query structures accompanied by a separate query variables block to retrieve modern graph-based entities.

Compose payloads as key-value pairs that automatically compile into standard x-www-form-urlencoded structures.

div.p: Run professional test cases and manage environments to parameterize your test cycles.

div.style: background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; display: flex; gap: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);

div.p: Define parameters like host, token, or port inside specific Environment scopes. Reference them inside your URLs, headers, or body components using the standard curly bracket syntax: {{host}}. The engine resolves them dynamically before execution.

div.style: background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; display: flex; gap: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);

div.p: Compose scripts to automatically validate HTTP response variables. Standard assertions let you verify status codes (e.g. status_code == 200), check headers, or validate specific JSON response keys.
